metadata.description: Plugins for building and maintaining the Lynk semantic layer.

plugins.name: lynk-semantic-layer
plugins.description: Build, edit, evaluate, validate, and ask read-only questions about a Lynk semantic layer in .lynk/, plus inspect data sources via the Lynk API — entities, metrics, features, relationships, glossary, domains, context files, backend validity checks, source schema/field inspection, and Q&A on Lynk concepts.
